items_flat.title_en: Sam Altman Demonstrates ChatGPT Work Completing Complex Multi-Step Agentic Tasks from Mobile
items_flat.title_zh: Sam Altman示範ChatGPT Work從手機完成複雜多步驟代理任務
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman posted that ChatGPT Work is “remarkable” and that “work” undersells it. From his phone he prompted it to use all his chat history to generate long-weekend trip ideas for eight friends, plan the best three options, build a full-stack coordination site, make reservations after group agreement, and draft a Gmail email — and it just worked. Later he agreed that ChatGPT Voice enabling computer control from anywhere also feels transformative.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI執行長Sam Altman表示ChatGPT Work「了不起」，「工作」一詞還不足以形容。他從手機指示系統利用全部聊天紀錄，為八位朋友產生長週末旅行點子、規劃前三選項、建立全端協調網站、處理團體共識與訂位，並草擬Gmail郵件，結果「就這樣成功了」。稍後他亦認同ChatGPT Voice讓人能在任何地方控制電腦完成工作，感覺具變革性。
items_flat.analysis_en: This CEO-level real-user demo from mobile underscores maturing reliability of agentic workflows that chain memory, research, coding, external tools and communication end-to-end. It positions OpenAI competitively against similar agent products, though broad non-executive consistency and edge-case robustness remain open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這次執行長從手機的真實使用示範，凸顯能串連記憶、研究、程式、外部工具與溝通的端到端代理工作流可靠性正在成熟。這讓OpenAI在代理產品競爭中站穩位置，但一般使用者端的一致性與邊緣案例穩健度仍待驗證。
items_flat.quote: chatgpt work is remarkable, and "work" undersells it. ... it...just worked.
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT Work了不起，「工作」一詞還不足以形容它。……它就這樣成功了。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA Expands Agent Toolkit with PhysicsNeMo and CUDA-X for Autonomous Engineering Agents
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA擴展Agent Toolkit，加入PhysicsNeMo與CUDA-X支援自主工程代理
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA announced an expansion of its Agent Toolkit integrating re-architected PhysicsNeMo libraries and updated CUDA-X libraries (including solvers and quantum chemistry tools). This enables developers to build autonomous AI engineers with AI physics skills, accelerated simulation and design capabilities. Partners including Cadence, Siemens, Synopsys, Samsung and TSMC are applying the toolkit to chip design, verification and systems workflows; Nemotron 3 Ultra is noted as leading open models on agentic RTL coding.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA宣布擴展Agent Toolkit，整合重新架構的PhysicsNeMo函式庫與更新的CUDA-X函式庫（含求解器與量子化學工具），讓開發者能打造具備AI物理技能、加速模擬與設計能力的自主AI工程師。Cadence、Siemens、Synopsys、Samsung與TSMC等合作夥伴正應用於晶片設計、驗證與系統工作流；Nemotron 3 Ultra在代理式RTL編碼上被指為開源模型領先者。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move extends agentic AI from general productivity into physics-constrained engineering domains, potentially accelerating chip and systems design cycles. Real impact depends on how readily domain experts adopt the agent interfaces and on measurable end-to-end speedups beyond the partner demos.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將代理式AI從一般生產力延伸到受物理約束的工程領域，有望加速晶片與系統設計週期。實際影響取決於領域專家對代理介面的採用程度，以及超越合作夥伴示範的端到端加速是否可測量。
items_flat.quote: Engineering has reached an inflection point. AI can now work with tools of physics, simulation and design.
items_flat.quote_zh: 工程已來到轉折點。AI現在能與物理、模擬與設計工具協同工作。

items_flat.title_en: xAI / Elon Musk Promote Grok Build CLI Updates Including Tutorial, Voice Prompting and Deep-Research
items_flat.title_zh: xAI／Elon Musk推廣Grok Build CLI更新：教學、語音提示與深度研究
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted multiple times promoting Grok Build, highlighting a new /tutorial command, voice prompting (Ctrl+Space), reliability improvements, workflow progress tracking, one-click resume, and the /deep-research command that uses bounded parallel agents to research, cross-check evidence and write cited reports. He also called Grok 4.5 a solid workhorse for real engineering tasks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk多次貼文推廣Grok Build，重點包括新的／tutorial指令、語音提示（Ctrl+Space）、可靠性改善、工作流進度追蹤、一鍵續跑，以及／deep-research指令（使用有界平行代理進行研究、交叉驗證證據並撰寫附引用報告）。他亦稱Grok 4.5是實用工程任務的可靠主力。
items_flat.analysis_en: These incremental CLI and interaction updates reinforce xAI’s focus on practical developer tooling and agent reliability rather than a new frontier model release. The emphasis on voice, deep-research agents and resume features aims to make long-running coding and research workflows more usable day-to-day.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些CLI與互動的增量更新，凸顯xAI聚焦實用開發者工具與代理可靠性，而非發布新旗艦模型。語音、深度研究代理與續跑功能，目標是讓長時間的程式與研究工作流在日常更可用。

brief_en: Quiet frontier day focused on agentic progress: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman demoed ChatGPT Work completing complex multi-step tasks from mobile. xAI advanced Grok Build CLI with deep-research, voice prompting and reliability updates. NVIDIA expanded Agent Toolkit with PhysicsNeMo and CUDA-X for physics-aware engineering agents used by Cadence, Synopsys and others.
brief_zh: 今日AI大廠動態平靜，聚焦代理能力：OpenAI執行長Altman示範ChatGPT Work從手機完成複雜多步驟任務。xAI持續更新Grok Build CLI深度研究、語音提示與可靠性。NVIDIA擴展Agent Toolkit加入PhysicsNeMo與CUDA-X，支援物理感知工程代理，獲Cadence、Synopsys等採用。
